github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
If the staged changes are in a /completed folder, generate the commit message using this template:

Finish {_problem_name_} (/completed)
  contains: description, solution.
  difficulty: {_problem_difficulty_}
  topics: {_problem_topics_}

If the staged changes are in a /incomplete folder, use this template:

Create {_problem_name_} (/incomplete)
  contains: description, solution.
  difficulty: {_problem_difficulty_}
  topics: {_problem_topics_}

Where:
- {_problem_name_} is the problem name/number, extracted from the folder name or description.txt.
- {_problem_difficulty_} is the difficulty, extracted from the 'difficulty:' line in description.txt.
- {_problem_topics_} is the topics, extracted from the 'topics:' line in description.txt.

Always extract these variables from the description.txt file in the relevant problem folder being committed.
